source.method: manual copy of the full mixed-school results page, filtered here to only the rows marked 'Hardy Middle School'
source.note: Names reformatted from the source's 'Last, First' order. Distance not stated in the paste; set to 4100m matching the Colmar Manor course used for other championship-level meets. The source's 'Avg. Mile' pace column was dropped, keeping only the finish time. No total team place/points were given (only per-athlete scoring positions, which weren't consistently listed), so no team_scores entry. Estaban Ceja and Oskar Floman also appear in the already-captured 2015-10-06 DCIAA Developmental #1 file, one year later, consistent with the same athletes. No time is close to the sub-19:00 (boys) / sub-21:00 (girls) individual record-wall cutoffs, so no wall changes.
